text: Among all distributions satisfying moment constraints E[f_i(X)] = a_i, the maximum-entropy distribution belongs to the:
choices: exponential family p(x) proportional to exp(sum lambda_i f_i(x))
explanation: Jaynes' principle yields an exponential-family (Gibbs) form exp(sum lambda_i f_i)/Z. Uniform is the special no-constraint case; Gaussian arises only for a variance constraint on the reals.
